decisions.reason: The source decision affects this Requirement, but its existing message-281 MODIFY already fully records GPIO3-controlled 5V-rail shutdown and the zero standby-current target.
Shutting down the separate 5V rail for LEDs does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail, its loads, or its source-selection behavior.
The source specifies control of the MT3608-based 5V rail and does not change the AXP2101 power-management role or battery power path.
The GPIO3-controlled 5V-rail shutdown does not alter DCDC1's 3.3V output voltage, current rating, or normal-operation role.
The source introduces LED-related 5V-rail control but does not change any ESP32 sleep mode, wake source, clock, or deep-sleep policy.
The 5V-rail shutdown behavior does not affect the battery connector type, contacts, compatibility, or unresolved physical pin order.
The source does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or other protection behavior.
The source addresses standby current of the addressable LEDs and does not necessarily alter the separate CHGLED output, connector, resistor, or D1 population requirements.
Software shutdown of the 5V rail has no effect on the power board's TVS ESD-protection requirement.
The source uses the existing 5V_EN interboard signal but does not change its connector, pin assignment, or pinout.
GPIO3 was already assigned as the 5V-enable GPIO; the source confirms its intended use without changing the mapping.
The electrical shutdown behavior does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or mechanical clearances.
